depth_targets.title: Last Accessed (service last-accessed data)
depth_targets.current_reason: Service last-accessed data requires long-term usage telemetry AWS aggregates in the background; Vyomi has no equivalent history to report.

depth_targets.title: Generate policy based on CloudTrail events
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi does not simulate CloudTrail, so there are no recorded events to mine a least-privilege policy from.

depth_targets.title: IAM Roles Anywhere
depth_targets.current_reason: Issuing short-term role credentials to on-premises/X.509-authenticated workloads is not modeled.

depth_targets.title: IAM Access Analyzer
depth_targets.current_reason: Resource analysis, unused-access findings and analyzer settings require cross-account reachability analysis Vyomi (a single-account appliance) has no basis to compute.

depth_targets.title: AWS Organizations multi-account features (root access management, organization activity, account access manager)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi simulates a single AWS account; there is no organization of member accounts for these multi-account features to operate over.
